what: A first-time install on a blank Windows 11, doing only what the README tells a new user to do, ending in a real switch through the dialog.
machine: Hyper-V test machine switcher-test put back to its clean Windows 11 Pro 25H2 (build 26200) restore point: no Hermes, no Python, no Git, no Node

hermes_install.how: Hermes's official Windows installer from the download page of its site: Hermes-Setup.exe, run by a normal signed-in user with a double-click and one press of Install
hermes_install.installer: 7.6 MB, SHA-256 cfc818adf831a748c61a407152a03c7a426ebee78f499d20a31fae2b5ac5d827, signature valid, signed by Nous Research Inc., issued by Microsoft ID Verified CS EOC CA 03, timestamped
hermes_install.result: Hermes v0.21.5+4531.g3cf2eb1 (upstream 3cf2eb1c), install method git, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes
hermes_install.finding: It builds the same install as the install script: the hermes-agent folder, bin\hermes.exe, and Hermes Desktop inside the checkout at apps\desktop\release\win-unpacked\Hermes.exe. The Desktop shortcuts point there. No gateway and no scheduled task exist after a fresh install.

what_a_new_machine_lacks: The python command on a fresh Windows is a stub that opens the Microsoft Store; git, node and py are not found. Hermes brings its own Python under tools\python-3.14.7+20260901-win32-x64.

plugin_install.step: setup.cmd, before any account was signed in
plugin_install.result: plugin code installed (13 files); settings not written; message: No Codex account is signed in to Hermes yet. Sign in with "hermes auth add openai-codex" (once per account), then run this again.

plugin_install.step: two Codex accounts signed in by their owner with Hermes's device sign-in (hermes auth add openai-codex)
plugin_install.result: both landed on the expected accounts, confirmed by the email inside each login
settings written: the folders of this install, gateway_service null, accounts personal and gmail

plugin_install.step: Hermes Desktop restarted; Capabilities, Plugins, Installed; the switch on the Account switch card turned on with the mouse
plugin_install.result: the status-bar button appeared: Codex: Personal

first_switch.route: status-bar button, dialog, account selector, Switch account button; mouse and keyboard only
first_switch.dialog_before: No active Hermes work blocked the restart check.
first_switch.gateway: none on a fresh install; Hermes Desktop alone was restarted
first_switch.billing_afterwards: every request on the wire carried the Gmail login; OpenAI answered; PASS

seen_along_the_way: Hermes Desktop's own first-run screen asks for a model provider before anything else.
The plugin's card has one switch; there is no separate switch labelled Desktop.

A banner 'Could not load agent plugins: request timed out after 30s: plugins.manage' showed on the Plugins screen when it was opened right after Hermes Desktop started, and was gone when the screen was reopened. Its cause was not established.
screenshots: C:/VMs/switcher-test/screens/ (setup-2, setup-progress, fresh-installed, fresh-toggle, fresh-dialog, fresh-selected, fresh-after-switch)
not_answered_by_this_run: An install through Hermes's catalog (hermes plugins install), which needs the public repository.
A machine where the user's own Python is on PATH in place of the Store stub (setup.cmd does not use it).
